rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides a continuously updated catalog of x402-payable services with real-time quality signals, facilitator-compatibility checks, and ERC-8004 trust scoring. Includes 5 discovery tools and 4 relay tools for routing payments to services. Also offers ScoutGate for wrapping existing APIs in x402 payments and an npm CLI for terminal-based catalog searches.
